items.title: Kittley Named Coach of the Week by CBS Sports
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – After a 60-point performance against first-place RV UTSA to secure Bowl eligibility, Florida Atlantic's Hagerty Family Head Football Coach Zach Kittley was selected by CBS Sports as the American Conference Coach of the Week.

items.title: Weekly ESPN+ Presser Features Coach Kittley, Batiste and Jones
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic's Hagerty Family Head Football Coach Zach Kittley will be joined by senior EDGE Deshaun Batiste and junior OL Aiden Jones for the weekly football press conference, which returns to Tuesday and will begin at 12 p.m., airing live on ESPN+.

items.title: Florida Atlantic to Host South Florida on ESPN+
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football will host American Conference and in-state foe South Florida on Saturday, Nov. 21, with the league announcing on Monday a 2:30 p.m. kickoff on ESPN+.

items.title: Veltkamp Earns Spot on Davey O’Brien Great 8
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's graduate QB Caden Veltkamp has been selected as a member of the Davey O'Brien Great 8 for the second time this season, announced on Monday afternoon. The weekly honor goes to the top eight quarterback performances, with one being named the National QB of the Week on Tuesday.

items.title: Messer Earns Back-to-Back Weekly Honorable Mentions
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – For the second consecutive week and fourth overall time in 2026, Florida Atlantic football's fifth-year WR Easton Messer received an accolade from the American Conference, named an Honorable Mention after his standout evening in the 60-29 win over RV UTSA.

items.title: Pads Off with Branden Hoch
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's sophomore WR Branden Hoch is featured in this week's "Pads Off", a segment hosted by Frank Forte where they talk anything but football.

items.title: Gabriel Birnbaum: Building a Business
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – While Gabriel Birnbaum entered college with a spot on the Florida Atlantic football team, he was still seeking purpose beyond the game. items.summary: The lights shone brightly on the Florida Atlantic Owls (6-3, 3-2) Thursday night as they faced the University of Texas at San Antonio Roadrunners (7-2, 4-1) in primetime on ESPN. The Owls took advantage of the opportunity to showcase the football talent they have been developing in Boca Raton, taking down UTSA, a team that...

items.title: Owls Bowl Bound after Scoring 60 Against First-Place UTSA
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football is bowl eligible for the sixth time in program history, and first since 2020, after defeating (RV) UTSA, 60-29, Thursday night on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium. Six wins are the program's most since 2019, and its best record through nine games since the same year.

items.title: Chandley Named to Midseason Ray Gay Watch List
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's junior P Reed Chandley has been named to the 2026 Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List, announced by the Augusta Sports Council on Thursday.
